summary: This bill requires the General Services Administration to collaborate with federal tenants of leased spaces to identify shared-space concerns, develop criteria and special-use strategies to expand sharing, set measurable success objectives, and brief congressional committees within six months.

scores.thoughts: The bill requires the GSA Administrator to collaborate with federal tenants on shared-space arrangements in federally-leased properties, develop criteria for expanded space-sharing, identify uses for special spaces to improve sharing, and set measurable objectives for success. This directly aims to optimize federal real estate usage, which should reduce leasing costs and overall government expenditures on office space. It builds on prior law to promote efficiency. While not a direct budget cut, it has a clear, moderate impact toward reducing government spending. Score: 0.6
